title: pebbles repo is not rustfmt-clean under current toolchains
description: cargo fmt -- --check fails on the current base (rustfmt 1.97): pre-existing diffs in src/display.rs, src/main.rs, src/projects.rs that the a52 worker did not touch. Worker gates now incorrectly trip on fmt unless they know it is pre-existing. Decide: pin a rustfmt version (rust-toolchain or CI-managed format step), or run a format pass and record which rustfmt the repo targets. Observed 2026-09-22 while landing pebble a525f10c.
